title: Demographic, Clinical and Laboratory Characteristics of Children With Alpha Thalassemia in Northern Israel
brief_summary: The study intends to summarize the clinical and laboratory characteristics of children with hemolytic anemia diagnosed as having alpha thalassemia mutations.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All the patients that were studied at the pediatric hematology unit ant the Ha'Emek Medical Center

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: A group of 50 children that underwent workup due to hemolytic anemia and were further diagnosis as suffering from clinical alpha thalassemia.
